title: Telemetry JSON must have no BOM
content: Node JSON.parse rejects a byte-order mark; serveJsonFile then returns {} and the dashboard silently shows static defaults. Write with UTF8Encoding($false).

title: PowerShell scripts are ASCII only
content: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less .ps1 as Windows-1252, so an em-dash breaks string parsing. No smart quotes or emoji in .ps1 files.

title: Restart cloudflared safely
content: Restart-Service Cloudflared alone hangs while it drains connections. restart-arunachala.ps1 gives it 15 s then kills it.

title: Access AUD changes when the app is recreated
content: If the Cloudflare Access app is recreated its AUD tag changes; update ACCESS_AUD or every tunnelled request gets 403.

title: SQLITE_BUSY on concurrent writers
content: Enable PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL and wrap writes in a retry with exponential backoff when the database is locked.

title: Supabase tables are prefixed
content: The Talia Supabase project is shared with other apps, so every Arunachala object is prefixed arunachala_. Never put a service_role key in .env.

title: Paid run cap
content: DISPATCH_DAILY_PAID_RUNS caps claude, codex, agy, mantis and auto runs per local day; hermes and noop are free. Over the cap the API answers 429.

title: Ollama is not a service
content: Ollama runs as the tray app only while the user is logged on; the watchdog restarts it every 5 minutes if 127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags does not answer.

title: PM2 respawns killed daemons
content: Never kill -9 a dashboard PID; PM2 restarts it. Use pm2 restart or pm2 reload ArunachalaDashboard.

title: LaunchAgent runs pm2 resurrect at login
content: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/pm2.arunachala.plist restores the saved process list at login, not at boot. After a node upgrade update the plist's nvm path.

title: OpenHands sandbox ports are LAN reachable
content: OpenHands publishes sandbox ports on all interfaces; they are protected only by each sandbox's session API key.

title: CanvasGate fails closed
content: canvas-gate.js refuses to start without CANVAS_ACCESS_AUD and re-verifies the Access JWT on every request and WebSocket.

title: Meilisearch master key location
content: MEILI_MASTER_KEY lives only in campusgtm_signals/.env on the Mac; frontends use the read-only MEILI_SEARCH_KEY from Vercel env.

title: Hermes runs are boxed in Docker
content: Every dispatched hermes run works in a container that sees only its worktree; git is not available inside and changes are committed on the host with hooks off.

title: Hermes needs OrbStack running
content: If docker ps cannot reach the daemon run orb start; a boxed hermes run fails rather than running unboxed.

title: Claude usage limit fallback
content: When a claude run ends on a 5-hour or weekly usage limit, the dispatch reruns the task with Hermes, read-only at the review level. CLAUDE_LIMIT_FALLBACK=off disables it.

title: Follow-ups resume the claude session
content: A follow-up runs claude --resume with the saved session id in the same worktree, so the agent remembers what it read; the resumed context is billed again.

title: Issue poller labels
content: agent:ready queues an issue, agent:running while it works, agent:review when a PR opens, agent:no-changes or agent:failed otherwise.

title: Review runs are read-only
content: PR reviews run claude with Edit, Write, commit, push, reset and checkout denied, and no team memories in the prompt because the comment is public.

title: Static files are allow-listed
content: static-policy.js decides what serveStaticFile sends; .env files, logs and json state return 404. A new asset folder needs a line there.

title: TASKS.md parsing is fragile
content: The task board parses markdown tables under Backlog, In Progress and Done; renaming a column header can silently break a section.

title: Drisyon tenant default bypasses isolation
content: search() with tenant:drisyon_core returns memories across every tenant unless STRICT_TENANT_ISOLATION=true.

title: Embeddings cache
content: nomic-embed-text vectors are cached in logs/embeddings-cache.json; cold search takes about a second, warm about 6 ms.

title: Secret scan gates every push
content: secret-scan.js runs before any agent branch is pushed; secret-looking files are listed by name, never shown in diffs.

title: Vercel deploys need the env var set per environment
content: A missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL in Preview made the build pass but every page 500 at runtime. Set env vars for Production and Preview.

title: Error ERR_REQUIRE_ESM from node-fetch v3
content: node-fetch 3 is ESM only; require() fails with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM. Use the global fetch in Node 18+ instead.

title: git worktree path rule
content: agent-dispatch.sh puts a run's worktree beside the repo as <repo>--<branch with / replaced by ->.

title: Approval cards time out
content: A risky tool call waits on an approval card for APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS (10 minutes); with nobody answering it is denied.

title: Run log is the source of truth
content: runs.jsonl holds a start and an end line per run and acts as the outbox for the Supabase run sync every 30 s.

title: Postgres error 42P01
content: relation does not exist (42P01) after a deploy meant the migration had not run on production; check schema_migrations before picking a migration number.
